axis_supply.supply_status: Strained for sustained operations. Primary constraint: 1,800km supply line from Tripoli/Benghazi over coastal road vulnerable to British interdiction and RAF bombing. Fuel shortages chronic due to Allied naval interdiction of Mediterranean convoys. Water supply critical in desert operations. Adequate for defensive operations but insufficient for prolonged offensive without resupply.

allied_supply.supply_status: Strained during Operation Crusader. Forward supplies adequate for defensive operations but insufficient for sustained offensive. Primary constraint: 1100km supply line from Mersa Matruh railhead. Water critical in desert environment - 4.5L per man per day. Frequent vehicle breakdowns due to sand abrasion on engines.
